$comment: Generated by `bun run ds:manifest` from libs/ui/src/lib/**/*.manifest.ts and libs/ui/src/ds-manifest/config.ts. Edit those, not this file.

Accordion.name: Accordion
intent: stacked expandable sections
Accordion.use_when: Several stacked sections where one or more can be open.

AiChatShell.name: AiChatShell
AiChatShell.use_when: Chat surfaces that talk to an assistant: prompt bar, streaming messages, approvals.

AutoSizerTable.name: AutoSizerTable
AutoSizerTable.use_when: A DataTable that fills its container height.

Avatar.name: Avatar
intent: a person or several people
Avatar.use_when: One person (initials or photo, tooltip, badge) or a stack of people with a +N tile.
never_when: a hand-rolled row of avatars or +N tile
a badge drawn on an avatar by hand
props_rules: size is a name (smaller, small, medium, large, larger), never a px number or CSS size

Badge.name: Badge
intent: an attribute, type or count on an item
a lifecycle state not covered by the state registry
Badge.use_when: A short label that states an attribute (Required, Inherited, a count) or a status of an item.
never_when: booleans or attributes most rows share (use Typography)
anything clickable (use Button look=string or Toggle)
an icon, dot, check or cross inside
a local span with rounded-full classes
props_rules: look is always the filled default, never outline
shape=rounded for lifecycle states, square for attributes
state colours follow the registry table: neutral initial, primary in process, warning needs attention, plum in review, positive done, negative failed
size via the size prop only, never className overrides

BadgeGroup.name: BadgeGroup
BadgeGroup.use_when: Several badges in one cell with overflow handling.

Button.name: Button
intent: something clickable that performs an action
a row of related actions
Button.use_when: Any element the user clicks to do something: submit, open, navigate, toggle a panel, icon-only controls.
never_when: a raw <button>, <a onClick> or div with role=button
a Badge or chip made clickable
more than one filled primary Button per screen
props_rules: look=filled only for the single main action; outlined or string for the rest
variant negative only for destructive actions, which also confirm

Checkbox.name: Checkbox
intent: select one or several items from a set
Checkbox.use_when: Selection of rows, options or items where several can be chosen at once, including indeterminate parents.

CodeBlock.name: CodeBlock
intent: read-only code or configuration
CodeBlock.use_when: Showing a snippet, a config or an ID the user may copy.

CodeEditor.name: CodeEditor
CodeEditor.use_when: Editable code with syntax highlighting (labeling config, scripts).

CollapsiblePanel.name: CollapsiblePanel
intent: an expandable panel-style section
CollapsiblePanel.use_when: A single section the user expands or collapses, panel style.
never_when: a details element styled by hand

CollectionUploader.name: CollectionUploader
CollectionUploader.use_when: The data-collection submission flow: upload, rules, status.

ContextMenu.name: ContextMenu
intent: a right-click menu
ContextMenu.use_when: Actions on an item opened with a right click or a kebab on canvas-like surfaces.
never_when: a Dropdown opened by right click by hand

DataTable.name: DataTable
intent: rows and columns of data
DataTable.use_when: Tabular data with sorting, selection, column sizing or virtualisation.
never_when: a grid of divs styled as a table

DateRangePicker.name: DateRangePicker
intent: pick a date or date-time range
DateRangePicker.use_when: Filtering or scoping by a period: a calendar with preset ranges and optional times, opened from DateRangePickerTrigger.
never_when: a single date with no range

Drawer.name: Drawer
intent: side editing with the page still visible
Drawer.use_when: A panel sliding in from an edge for editing or details while the page context stays visible.
never_when: a fixed-position div animated by hand

Dropdown.name: Dropdown
intent: a list of actions behind a trigger
Dropdown.use_when: A menu of actions or options that opens from a button, a cell or a card.
never_when: raw buttons styled as menu items

EmptyState.name: EmptyState
intent: nothing to show
EmptyState.use_when: No data, no results or a first-run screen: icon, title, description and the action that fills it.

EnterpriseUpgradeOverlay.name: EnterpriseUpgradeOverlay
EnterpriseUpgradeOverlay.use_when: Blurs an Enterprise-only area with an upgrade call to action.

FilterShell.name: FilterShell
FilterShell.use_when: The chip-and-popover shell that filter rows share.

InputFile.name: InputFile
intent: pick a file from disk
InputFile.use_when: A control that opens the file picker for one or several files.
never_when: the full collection upload flow (use CollectionUploader)

JsonViewer.name: JsonViewer
JsonViewer.use_when: Expandable, virtualised JSON for task data and results.

Label.name: Label
intent: a caption for a form control
Label.use_when: The text, required marker and description attached to a control.
never_when: a bare <label> or Typography placed next to a control by hand

Message.name: Message
intent: an inline notice
a page-level notice with a title
Message.use_when: Info, warning, error or success text placed inline with the content it refers to.

ModalWindow.name: ModalWindow
intent: a blocking decision or a focused task
ModalWindow.use_when: A dialog the user must act on or dismiss: confirmations, forms, previews.
never_when: side editing that keeps the page visible (use Drawer)
props_rules: destructive confirmations use a negative Button and, for high impact, typed validation
one-line confirmations and notices open with confirm() / info() from @humansignal/ui, never a hand-built Dialog
status text next to the actions goes in footerMeta, left of the buttons

MultiTreeSelect.name: MultiTreeSelect
MultiTreeSelect.use_when: The provider-backed multi-tree picker used by pickers and the taxonomy editor until the unified TreeSelect lands.

Pagination.name: Pagination
intent: move through pages of a list
Pagination.use_when: Page controls for lists and tables, with page size where the list supports it.

Popover.name: Popover
intent: rich content anchored to a trigger
Popover.use_when: Interactive or formatted content that opens next to its trigger and closes on outside click or Escape.

ResizeHandle.name: ResizeHandle
ResizeHandle.use_when: The drag handle between resizable panels.

SearchInput.name: SearchInput
intent: filter a list by typing
SearchInput.use_when: A search box that narrows a list or table as the user types.
never_when: a raw <input> with a magnifier icon

SegmentedControl.name: SegmentedControl
intent: switch the view or format of the same content
pick one of up to five visible options
SegmentedControl.use_when: Switching views, filtering the same data or showing the same content in another format (list or grid, form or JSON, a short filter). MultiStateToggle is its deprecated old name.
never_when: moving between sub-sections whose content differs (use Tabs)
options that need descriptions (use Radio once it exists)

Select.name: Select
intent: pick one or several values from a flat list
Select.use_when: Choosing from a flat list of options, single or multiple, searchable or not, with read-only display mode.
never_when: free text (use Input once it exists)

SimpleCard.name: SimpleCard
intent: a titled surface grouping related content
SimpleCard.use_when: A bordered surface with an optional title and description around a group of controls or data.
never_when: a div with border and shadow classes
SimpleCard.notes: The product Card until the library's four card implementations collapse into one; lib/Card, card-new and the shad card are internal.

Skeleton.name: Skeleton
intent: a layout still loading
Skeleton.use_when: Placeholder blocks in the shape of the content that is about to appear.
never_when: grey divs with a pulse class

Space.name: Space
intent: evenly spaced siblings
Space.use_when: A horizontal or vertical row of controls with design-system gaps.
never_when: margins on each child by hand

Sparkles.name: Sparkles
Sparkles.use_when: The AI sparkle decoration on assistant entry points.

Spinner.name: Spinner
intent: an action in progress
Spinner.use_when: Something the user triggered is still running and has no layout to reserve.
never_when: loading a layout that will be filled (use Skeleton)
an app-local spinner or CSS animation
props_rules: size is a name (smallest, smaller, small, medium, large, larger, largest), never a px number

StateChip.name: StateChip
intent: the lifecycle state of a task, project or annotation
StateChip.use_when: A state that comes from the state registry in @humansignal/app-common (TaskStateChip, AnnotationStateChip, ProjectStateChip wrap it).
never_when: a Badge with a colour picked at the call site for a registered state

Stepper.name: Stepper
intent: progress through a multi-step flow
Stepper.use_when: Wizards and setup flows with ordered steps.

Tabs.name: Tabs
intent: move between sub-sections of one section
Tabs.use_when: Navigating between sub-sections of a parent section whose content differs but sits at the same level.
never_when: switching the view, format or filter of the same content (use SegmentedControl)
a row of Buttons with an active class

TaxonomyMultiTreeSelect.name: TaxonomyMultiTreeSelect
TaxonomyMultiTreeSelect.use_when: Taxonomy selection in the labeling editor.

TaxonomySelectionList.name: TaxonomySelectionList
TaxonomySelectionList.use_when: The read-only list of selected taxonomy paths.

ThemeToggle.name: ThemeToggle
ThemeToggle.use_when: The light, dark and auto theme switch.

Toast.name: Toast
intent: the result of an action, shown briefly
Toast.use_when: Confirmation or failure of an action the user just took, through useToast.
never_when: alert() or a hand-made notification bar

Toggle.name: Toggle
intent: an on/off setting
Toggle.use_when: A setting that is either on or off and takes effect as a preference (auto-save, notifications, a feature switch).
never_when: choosing one of several named options (use SegmentedControl or Select)

Tooltip.name: Tooltip
intent: a short explanation on hover or focus
Tooltip.use_when: Plain-text help attached to a control or a truncated value.

TreeSelect.name: TreeSelect
TreeSelect.use_when: Choosing from a hierarchy, single or multiple, searchable.

Typography.name: Typography
intent: any product copy
Typography.use_when: Every piece of user-visible text: headings, body, labels, metadata, truncation.

intent: free text entry
Input.use_when: A single-line text field with leading or trailing elements and error state.

intent: multi-line text entry
TextArea.use_when: A resizable multi-line text field with error state.

intent: pick one of several described options
Radio.use_when: Mutually exclusive options that need a label and a description each.

intent: bind a control to a form with label, description and error
FormField.use_when: The wrapper that registers any control with a form and renders its Label, description and validation error.

internal.Header: DataTable column header helper; use it through DataTable column definitions.
internal.DropdownContext: React context behind Dropdown; use useDropdown.
internal.ToastContext: React context behind Toast; use useToast.
internal.TreeSearchIndex: Search index class used by MultiTreeSelect.
internal.TreeSearchMatch: Search match class used by MultiTreeSelect.
